summary: Engineering AI-enabled features, full-stack application modules, and intelligent candidate matching for the EZSTAF recruitment platform.
responsibilities: Developed a full-featured Applicant Management System to streamline end-to-end recruitment and hiring workflows.
Integrated an LLM-powered chatbot for both recruiters and applicants using Mistral and MCP servers, enabling the chatbot to access tools relevant to recruitment workflows.

Worked on AI job-matching and candidate-matching workflows using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), Sentence Transformers embeddings, and the Pinecone vector database to retrieve and rank relevant candidates.

Developed and integrated REST APIs using FastAPI, supporting application workflows and communication between the frontend and backend, with request/response data handled through defined JSON contracts.
Worked with complex PostgreSQL schemas and table relationships, including foreign-key dependencies, to support consistent data retrieval and reliable connections across recruitment-related entities.

Implemented Flutter/Dart frontend integrations following the project’s layered architecture, and used Neon PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch for global search, Git/GitHub and Git Bash for version-control workflows, and Postman for API testing.
